title: News and events: data/content/events.json
description: Written by a person: only what the owner has actually announced. scripts/sync_site_chrome.py writes it into event.html (rows by start date, notices newest first). A detail value may carry <strong> and no other markup (validate_content.py); every other text is plain. docs/EVENT_DETAIL_FIELDS.md.

confirmation.description: What was announced or verified. A date passing never makes an activity held.

link.description: The original post (https://), or a page of this site where people take part (name.html; it must exist).

entry.description: The start screen of the activity shown right in its card while it runs (its link must be that page). Only the menu world cup has one.

previewFrom.description: Lab only (js/worldcup-gate.js): from this KST date babdoduk-lab.vercel.app and localhost treat the activity as started, so it can be tested before `start`. Production ignores it. Only an activity with an entry has one, and it is not after `start`.

details.description: The fixed labelled rows (summary, duration, prizes, participation; at least the summary), or one note for an activity they do not fit.
